description: Translate raw voice metrics (jitter, shimmer, HNR, CPPS, F0, etc.) into clinical-language interpretation with severity classification (normal / mild / moderate / severe) and actionable recommendations. Useful when you have metric values from other tools and want a clinician-readable summary. BEFORE CALLING: Pass metrics that come from Vocametrix measurement tools (e.g. vocametrix_calculate_jitter_shimmer, vocametrix_calculate_hnr, vocametrix_calculate_cpp). Do not invent or estimate values — passing arbitrary numbers produces misleading clinical output.

languageCode.description: Language for the report (en, fr, etc.)

metrics.description: Voice metrics object (e.g. { jitter: 1.2, shimmer: 3.5, hnr: 18.0 })

patientGender.description: Patient biological sex for norm reference

name: vocametrix_interpret_voice_metrics
